questions.questionText:
A force acting on a moving ball causes its motion to change. This force stays constant.
What makes the force produce a greater change in the motion of the ball?

options.text: decreasing the total mass of the ball
increasing the temperature of the ball
using a ball with a hollow centre but the same mass
using a different material for the ball so that it has a lower density but the same mass

other has four wide wheels.
narrow wheel wide wheel
Which cart wheels sink less into soft ground and what is the reason?
cart wheels reason

options.text: narrow greater pressure on the ground
narrow less pressure on the ground
wide greater pressure on the ground
wide less pressure on the ground

Which row describes the separation and the motion of the particles of a hot gas compared to
those of a cool liquid?
separation of gas particles motion of gas particles

options.text: greater than a cool liquid faster than a cool liquid
greater than a cool liquid slower than a cool liquid
less than a cool liquid faster than a cool liquid
less than a cool liquid slower than a cool liquid

questions.questionText:
The specific heat capacity of solid P is greater than that of solid Q.
What does this statement mean?

options.text: Less energy is needed to raise the temperature by 1°C of unit mass of solid P than unit mass of solid Q.
Less energy is needed to melt unit mass of solid P than unit mass of solid Q.
More energy is needed to raise the temperature by 1°C of unit mass of solid P than unit mass of solid Q.
More energy is needed to melt unit mass of solid P than unit mass of solid Q.

A sealed container of gas is heated. The pressure of the gas increases.
Which statement explains this increase in pressure?

options.text: The forces of the gas particles striking the walls of the container increase.
The forces of attraction between the gas particles and the walls of the container increase.
The gas particles collide with each other more frequently.
The gas particles lose more energy when they strike the walls of the container.

questions.questionText:
A student has a copper rod and a wooden rod. Both rods have the same dimensions.
The student puts one end of each rod into a beaker of crushed ice.
After a few minutes, the student picks up the rods by the ends not in the ice.
Which statement is correct?

options.text: The copper rod feels colder than the wooden rod because copper is a better conductor than wood.
The copper rod feels warmer than the wooden rod because copper is a better conductor than wood.
The wooden rod feels colder than the copper rod because wood is a better conductor than copper.
The wooden rod feels warmer than the copper rod because wood is a better conductor than copper.

questions.questionText:
Copper wire is available in fixed lengths but in various diameters d. Each wire has a different
resistance R.
Which relationship between R and d is correct?

options.text: R is directly proportional to d.
R is directly proportional to d2.
R is inversely proportional to d.
R is inversely proportional to d2.

looking from vertically above the wire?

A simple transformer contains an iron core.
What is the function of the iron core in the transformer?

options.text: to conduct current from the primary coil to the secondary coil
to enable the secondary coil to act as an electromagnet
to ensure there is a high voltage between the primary coil and the secondary coil
to link the magnetic field in the primary coil to the secondary coil

options.text: Redshift is a decrease in the observed wavelength of electromagnetic radiation emitted from receding galaxies.

questions.questionText: Which statement about the cosmic microwave background radiation (CMBR) is correct?

options.text: CMBR now has a frequency higher than that of infrared radiation.
CMBR has always had exactly the same frequency.
CMBR had a shorter wavelength in the past.

CMBR was produced a long time after the Universe was formed.
